title: ReceiptOps · verified agent execution
caption: Actual product screens captured from the Vultr deployment on 9 November 2026.
narration: Receipt Ops is an invoice audit with evidence you can check after the run. This walkthrough uses actual screens from the working Vultr deployment. The model writes the program. A separate checker decides whether the answer is correct.

title: 01 · A specific task, with a bounded input
caption: Eight fictional rows. Duplicate rows stay in the totals. Only the contract reaches the model.
narration: The input is a small fictional invoice ledger. The task is to calculate balances, identify overdue invoices, and flag duplicate identifiers. Duplicate rows remain in the totals. Vultr inference receives the task contract and schema. The invoice rows stay in the execution environment.

title: 02 · Execute, then independently check
caption: Live Vultr inference → isolated Docker execution → independent Decimal checker.
narration: The agent generated Python and ran it in a disposable container. The independent checker confirmed every result field. The overdue amount is three thousand, two hundred twenty, point five zero. Invoice one thousand four is duplicated. The execution receipt records the model, input hash, result, and confirmed container cleanup.

title: 03 · Make the boundary observable
caption: Eight checks passed on Vultr, including a blocked network attempt and forced timeout.
narration: The containment panel runs real probes. The external network attempt is blocked. The input and root filesystem cannot be changed. The process is unprivileged, and neither the inference key nor the Docker socket is present. A timed loop is terminated, and the containers are removed. All eight checks passed on Vultr.

title: 04 · Verify the genuine receipt
caption: The signature and content hash match the deployment’s trusted public key.
narration: The receipt inspector verifies the signed record against this deployment's public key. The original receipt is valid. Judges can also download the complete evidence bundle and use the offline verifier, which recomputes the invoice answer without calling a model or executing the generated program.

title: 05 · Change one signed field
caption: The changed run ID is rejected. No successful verification is claimed for the altered record.
narration: Now the run identifier is changed. Verification rejects the modified receipt. This makes changes to the signed record detectable. The signature authenticates the host's record; it does not prove that the host itself is honest. Docker also shares the host kernel.

title: ReceiptOps · AI Evaluation Lab
caption: Rama Chandra M · Public sample demo: http://155.138.211.247 · MIT source on GitHub.
narration: The evidence includes twenty four passing tests, a live Vultr invoice audit, eight passing containment checks, and successful offline verification. Receipt Ops was built by Rama Chandra M at AI Evaluation Lab. The source and signed evidence are public. This prototype uses fictional data and does not approve or move money.
